evidence: Nestled within the heart of Hanoi’s bustling Old Quarter, Hang Buom Street, also known as Phố Hàng Buồm, stands as a testament to the city’s rich cultural heritage and dynamic present. Historically, this narrow thoroughfare ran alongside the tranquil banks of the Tô Lịch River, renowned for its traditional weaving and trading of rattan and fabric sails used by boats navigating the region’s waterways.
